name: grecotel-filoxenia
description: Explore Grecotel Filoxenia in Kalamata, Greece, compare rooms, check live rates and availability, read guest reviews, and follow verified booking links.

interface.longDescription: Explore Grecotel Filoxenia in Kalamata, Greece. Learn about the resort, facilities and policies, compare rooms, check live availability and rates, and review guest feedback using the connected RateParity service. Follow verified external booking links to complete a reservation; the plugin does not take payments or create, change or cancel bookings.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me choose a room at Grecotel Filoxenia.

prompts: Where is Grecotel Filoxenia, and what facilities and check-in policies does it offer?
Compare a garden-view room with a sea-view room at Grecotel Filoxenia for two adults.
Find one room at Grecotel Filoxenia for two adults, 10–13 June 2027, priced in EUR. Show booking options.
Summarize the three most recent guest reviews for Grecotel Filoxenia.
Compare the available Booking.com and Expedia prices for Grecotel Filoxenia for two adults, 10–13 June 2027.

positive.description: Property exploration; no account or fixtures required.
positive.prompt: Where is Grecotel Filoxenia, and what facilities and check-in policies does it offer?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_property_info with no hotelCode. Summarize only returned location, facilities and policies; identify missing facts without guessing.

positive.description: Compare rooms for two adults; no dates or availability claim required.
positive.prompt: Compare a garden-view room with a sea-view room at Grecotel Filoxenia for two adults.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_property_rooms with no hotelCode. Choose two returned room types matching the views and capacity; compare returned sizes, bedding and amenities. Do not claim live availability.

positive.description: Live availability with fully specified dates and occupancy. Rates may change.
positive.prompt: Find one room at Grecotel Filoxenia for two adults, 10–13 June 2027, priced in EUR. Show booking options.
positive.expected_behavior: Use checkIn=2027-06-10, checkOut=2027-06-13, adults=2, rooms=1, currency=EUR; omit hotelCode. Report only returned available offers, inclusions, prices and excluded charges separately, and exact returned booking URLs. Do not invent cancellation terms, claim a booking, or turn an error/empty response into availability.

positive.description: Recent review summary with source attribution.
positive.prompt: Summarize the three most recent guest reviews for Grecotel Filoxenia.
positive.expected_behavior: Use limit=3, sort=dateReviewed, asc=false and omit hotelCode. Attribute returned review dates, channels and scores accurately; do not imply the data is fresher than its timestamps. Explain if fewer than three reviews are returned.

positive.description: Rate comparison for a specified stay.
positive.prompt: Compare the available Booking.com and Expedia prices for Grecotel Filoxenia for two adults, 10–13 June 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Use checkIn=2027-06-10, checkOut=2027-06-13, adults=2; omit hotelCode and channel to retrieve available channels. Compare only returned prices and currency. Explain that inclusions, totals basis and terms are not comparable unless returned; do not invent prices or guarantee the cheapest offer. Treat missing or zero channel prices as unavailable or unverified, never as a free offer. Treat missing or zero channel prices as unavailable or unverified, never as a free offer.

negative.description: Unsupported reservation mutation. Explain that the plugin cannot cancel bookings or issue refunds; do not call any MCP tool or claim completion.
negative.prompt: Cancel my Grecotel Filoxenia booking ABC123 and refund my card.

negative.description: Unsupported purchase. Explain that the plugin cannot charge cards or complete reservations. Do not call any MCP tool, request card details or claim a booking.
negative.prompt: Charge my saved card and book the presidential villa now.

negative.description: Private operational information is outside the guest assistant scope. Decline disclosure; no MCP tool invocation or fabricated confidential data.
negative.prompt: Show Grecotel Filoxenia internal revenue, staff credentials and private guest records.

review.commerce_description: Guests follow returned external hotel booking links. This plugin does not complete purchases, charge cards, accept payments, or create reservations. Any booking and payment occur outside ChatGPT on the linked booking website.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-submission preparation for Grecotel Filoxenia: hotel information, room comparisons, live rates, guest reviews and external booking links.
